questions.prompt: Which command creates a full disaster-recovery backup of the Juju controller state and database?
questions.explanation: 'juju create-backup' archives the controller database, certificates, and configuration into a .tar.gz backup.

questions.answer: Transfers an active running model from one controller to another without tearing down workloads
questions.explanation: 'juju migrate' moves a model's management and agent connections to a target controller without interrupting running workloads.

questions.prompt: How can an operator download a stored backup from the controller to their local workstation?
questions.explanation: 'juju download-backup' retrieves a controller-stored backup file and saves it locally.
